Method of Attack: Deployed an executable for Windows that sent sensitive information to a remote server
Included a password recovery tool (WebBrowserPassView) to steal website login information from browsers
Submitted stolen credentials to the author's web server
Changed storage location for stolen data
Deleted stolen data after sending to remote machine
Discoverer: Tomislav Pericin, co-founder and chief software architect at ReversingLabs
Attack Vector: Compromised account owner's credentials to publish package
